newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Profit up 37 pct at Belgian electronics firm Barco.
newsitem.headline: Profit up 37 pct at Belgian electronics firm Barco.

text.p: Belgian electronics firm Barco NV said on Wednesday net profit climbed 37 percent in the first half of 1996, and it expected full year current profit to rise 25 percent.

"Barco also expects to be able to have 10 to 15 percent growth of current net profit internally in 1997," the company said in a statement, adding, "This growth doesn't take account of any future acquisitions."
Concerning acquisitions the company said that it currently had over five billion Belgian francs ($160.5 million) in available cash.
Barco's consolidated net profit rose to 1.13 billion Belgian francs in the first half of 1996 from 823 million in the year ago period.
Consolidated turnover climbed 19 percent to 8.9 billion francs. Turnover rose across its divisions, with its cable and satellite division showing a rise of 70 percent. ($ = 31.16 Belgian Francs)
